api.name: NativeSettingsPlugin
api.docs:
Capacitor NativeSettings plugin interface.

Provides access to native Android and iOS system settings screens.

methods.name: open

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A promise resolving to the operation result.

methods.docs: Opens the specified settings option on the current platform.

methods.name: openAndroid

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A promise resolving to the operation result.

methods.docs: Opens the specified Android settings screen.

methods.name: openIOS

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Apple officially supports opening only the app-specific settings screen.
Using other options may result in App Store rejection.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A promise resolving to the operation result.

methods.docs: Opens the specified iOS settings screen.
